# Ledger of the ladder theorem (generated by scripts/s5_ledger.py)

The conclusion LADDER = B and C and M, with M = M_direct or M_transfer. A failure of the conclusion is a failure of at least one leaf below.

## Area side (B)

| Leaf | Kind | Statement | Where |
|---|---|---|---|
| H4 | HYP | (GEO) the gravitational side of the second-order first law is the extremal value of (Area - 2 Volume)/4G, a diffeomorphism-invariant functional of the metric |  |
| H5 | HYP | (EIN) the family g_eps solves the vacuum Einstein equations through O(eps^2); only the second-order Hamiltonian constraint is used |  |
| T5 | TEXTBOOK | first and second variation of area and volume of a hypersurface (used for the displacement quadratic form) |  |
| c_s1 | COMPUTED | scope-family identities M1-M8 (K TT harmonic, K_nn = 0, dE = (l+1)K, Ric_3(2NK) = (l+2)K, cut vector, pairing, A, S), l = 2..5, four harmonics each | wave69/final/out/s1_modular_side.json |
| c_s2 | COMPUTED | area-side identities B1-B6 (Green, k = 2, constraint, total = A in three second-order gauges, no drive, displacement form) | wave69/final/out/s2_area_side.json |
| p_B | PROOF | the extremal value of A - 2V has second-order coefficient -A/2 on every vacuum family with first-order part 2tK plus gauge | THEOREM.md Sec. 7 |
| p_Bz | PROOF | the seven Poincare zero modes are not driven at O(eps^2) on a single-l stationary datum (parity and time reflection) | THEOREM.md Sec. 7, B-e |

| Leaf | Kind | Statement | Where |
|---|---|---|---|
| H0 | HYP | Scope (a definition, the author 10 Nov): the theory is free linearised gravity at order G^0 on Minkowski space, d = 4, the free helicity-2 curvature net on the TT Fock space; the region is the unit ball; the state is a stationary magnetic multipole, l >= 2 |  |
| H1 | HYP | (A1) the ball's states are the image of the world's states under one normal unital completely positive map Phi: M -> B(F) |  |
| H2 | HYP | (A2) no signalling: Phi(M) commutes with every curvature observable in the causal complement of the diamond |  |
| H3 | HYP | (A3) M contains the interior curvature observables: a normal unital *-homomorphism iota: A(D) -> M with Phi iota = id |  |
